newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee prices plummet in late sell-off.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee prices plummet in late sell-off.

text.p: CSCE coffee futures nosedived just ahead of the close on Friday, as panicky broad-based selling on the heels of a spectacular three-day run-up battered the market, traders said.
"It's get me out, get me out," said one trader.
At 1332 EDT, July plunged 39.80 cents per lb, to 276.00 cents, after ranging from 311.00 to 273.00 cents. Second-month September was 36.80 lower, at 237.00, while the back months fell 4.55 to 9.00.
In buying the last three days, the benchmark July contract gained a hefty 57.95 cents -- or more than 22 percent -- to peak at a lifetime high of 318.00 cents a lb, a level not seen since 1977.
Volume as of 1300 EDT, reached an estimated 8,352 lots.
